name: Evidence specimen ledger
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application composition study, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design a shippable assessment operations dashboard called "Ultra13 Agent Benchmark". The job is to track 100 open-source AI agents, ingest only Ultra13-generated JSON evidence, calculate a transparent benchmark score out of 100, and show cohort trends. This is composition C: the dominant organizing idea is an evidence-first specimen ledger, where every scored claim can be traced to a literal JSON field and unknowns are visible gaps.
Subject and hierarchy: a narrow top identity band with exact title "ULTRA13 AGENT BENCHMARK", "3 / 100 assessed", and primary action "UPLOAD ULTRA13 JSON"; a compact vertical index of 100 small numbered agent tabs on the far left with color-coded lifecycle state; a central selected-agent specimen sheet for "openai-agents-python" dominated by exact score "82 / 100" and four horizontal score plates labeled Assurance 18/20, MAESTRO 33/40, OWASP ASI 21/25, Findings 10/15; directly below each component, show deductions, unknown counts, and JSON source paths; the far right is a raw evidence lineage column with schema version, SHA-256 digest, captured time, build identity, compatibility status, and literal label "ULTRA13 DATA ONLY"; the lower third is a cohort comparison strip with sorted score marks for assessed agents, empty slots for unassessed agents, and small multiples for lifecycle, score distribution, MAESTRO outcomes, and ASI outcomes.
Style/medium: realistic product UI, not concept art; scientific specimen archive and auditor evidence ledger; crisp, measured, editorial data visualization; flat interface, no perspective device frame.
Composition/framing: full browser viewport at 1440x900; evidence derivation is the first visual read; fixed comparison cells; workflow remains visible as a thin indexed strip, not hidden in navigation.
Color palette: warm off-white archive paper, deep midnight-indigo structural bands, cobalt blue, saffron amber, oxygen cyan, restrained coral only for blockers; high contrast and accessible.
Typography: bold condensed grotesk for headings, highly readable humanist sans for UI, monospaced numerals only for identifiers, JSON paths, and measurements.
Materials/textures: subtle hairline rules, paper registration ticks, and restrained specimen labels; otherwise clean digital surfaces.
Text (verbatim where legible): "ULTRA13 AGENT BENCHMARK", "openai-agents-python", "82 / 100", "SCORE DERIVATION", "ULTRA13 DATA ONLY", "UNKNOWN: 7", "UPLOAD ULTRA13 JSON", "NOT A NATIVE ULTRA13 SCORE".
Constraints: show score derivation and provenance rather than a decorative circular gauge; unknown evidence remains unknown; no runtime claims; practical controls; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no excessive rounded cards; no decorative illustration; no charts without axes or labels; no logos, trademarks, watermarks, or extra marketing copy.
